info.name: Cinema BE2 — Task 5 — Checkout, Cancellation and Expiry
info.description: Implemented BE2 tasks 1–5. Run 01–26 in order for Guest, selection, reservation, recovery and explicit cancellation. Complete reservation before the original five-minute deadline. The optional 27–30 folder creates another booking and waits for natural expiry (about five minutes plus the configured worker interval); run it separately if desired. Uses real local demo data. The API background worker releases only eligible overdue pending holds; it never infers an unresolved payment failed. No gateway, payment, ticket, email or refund is created. Replace older imports with revision 1.5.0.

item.name: 16 Recover checkout without creating a booking

request.description: pay is a navigation hint for an eligible positive-total pending demo booking. It does not initiate MoMo or mark payment successful. After the deadline expect selectAgain.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('bookingId')) throw new Error('Run request 11 successfully first; bookingId must be captured in the selected environment.');
const data = pm.response.json().data; const booking = data.booking;
pm.test('No payment created on reload', () => { pm.expect(data.payment).to.eql(null); pm.expect(booking.activePaymentId).to.eql(null); pm.expect(booking.paymentDeadline).to.eql(null); });

pm.test('Recovery hint respects server deadline', () => pm.expect(data.nextAction).to.eql(Date.parse(booking.selectionDeadline) > Date.parse(data.serverTime) && booking.showtime.bookingAvailable ? 'pay' : 'selectAgain'));

item.name: 29 Wait and poll until worker persists expiry

request.description: In Collection Runner/Newman this polls once per second until expired, bounded by expiryWaitSeconds (default 420). With Send, send it again after the original five-minute deadline plus worker interval. No public worker trigger or clock mutation is used.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('bookingId')) throw new Error('Run request 11 successfully first with this Guest cookie and selected environment.');
pm.test('Worker expired booking within configured wait', () => pm.expect(data.booking.status).to.eql('expired')); pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);
